items.title: IDC Frontier (SoftBank cloud subsidiary) — ransomware outage hits 495 customers
items.summary: A ransomware attack reported October 7 on SoftBank's cloud subsidiary IDC Frontier disrupted 495 companies and local governments, halting Nissui Logistics' logistics system at 17 sites and taking Ibaraki Prefecture's websites offline; no group has been named.

items.title: DexCom — claimed by "Redact" group
items.summary: A group calling itself Redact posted a claim against US medical-device maker DexCom on October 10; the claim is unverified and DexCom has not confirmed an incident.

items.title: SilentRansomGroup — two new victims listed with names withheld
items.summary: SilentRansomGroup listed two partially redacted victims on October 5 and October 7, with full names held back behind the leak site's countdown timer; neither listing is confirmed.

items.title: Japan — record 123 ransomware incidents in H1 2026
items.summary: Japan's National Police Agency counted a record 123 ransomware incidents in the first half of 2026, and more than 20 major Japanese companies have disclosed attacks in recent weeks.

items.title: BlackFog — State of Ransomware, September 2026
items.summary: The most recent full monthly roundup covers September; no October roundup has been published yet.

ransomware.note: October coverage is thin: apart from IDC Frontier, the named victims are unverified leak-site claims.

items.title: Google Cloud Storage — us-central1 degradation, October 8
items.summary: Cloud Storage in us-central1 (Iowa) saw elevated latency and errors on writes and some reads for roughly 11 to 12 hours on October 8; Google's preliminary account cites a traffic-sorting change that exhausted backend storage nodes plus a separate metadata database problem, with a full root cause still pending.

items.title: Yandex Cloud — three data centers damaged, October 8–11
items.summary: Yandex said drone attacks damaged data centers in Sasovo, Kaluga and Vladimir, shutting down two and partly disabling the third, leaving customers unable to reach cloud-hosted files; the attribution rests on Yandex's own statements.

outage.note: No major active AWS, Azure, Cloudflare or Microsoft 365 incident was found this week. The IDC Frontier cloud outage is listed under Ransomware.

items.title: Times Car (Japan) — 6.6 million member accounts leaked
items.summary: An attack on car-sharing service Times Car in September leaked data on about 6.6 million member accounts, including images of driving licences.

items.title: JR East — 1.67 million customer email addresses exposed
items.summary: Rail operator JR East lost 1.67 million customer email addresses, one of a run of Japanese disclosures that also includes Lawson, Daiwa Securities and Bookoff.

items.title: CISA KEV — Joomla iCagenda and Balbooa extension flaws
items.summary: CISA added two Joomla extension vulnerabilities to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after active zero-day attacks on the iCagenda and Balbooa extensions; the addition date could not be confirmed from the source.

items.title: KEV and zero-day pace — 247 KEV additions through October 1
items.summary: An October 1 roundup counts 247 CISA KEV additions between January 1 and October 1, 2026, and cites Google Threat Intelligence Group's figure of about 11 zero-days a month from January to August.

cyber.note: No new October-dated CISA emergency directive or major zero-day disclosure surfaced in today's search.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias — federal emergency declarations for Florida, Alabama and Georgia
items.summary: Emergency declarations were approved for Florida and Alabama on October 9 and Georgia on October 10 (incident periods starting October 6, 7 and 8), with FEMA pre-positioning resources and warning of life-threatening storm surge along the Florida Panhandle and Alabama coasts; category and landfall details were not confirmed.

items.title: M 7.7 — 12 km WSW of Pitaloza Arriba, Panama (Oct 09)
items.summary: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake on October 9 with a USGS PAGER alert level of orange; no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.7 — central Mid-Atlantic Ridge (Oct 13)
items.summary: Magnitude 6.7 earthquake on October 13 in the remote central Mid-Atlantic Ridge; PAGER alert green.

items.title: M 6.6 — 14 km W of Río Grande, Panama (Oct 09)
items.summary: Magnitude 6.6 earthquake on October 9 following the M 7.7 the same day; USGS tsunami flag set, PAGER alert yellow.

items.title: M 6.3 — 102 km NE of Norsup, Vanuatu (Oct 08)
items.summary: Magnitude 6.3 earthquake on October 8 off Vanuatu; PAGER alert green.

items.title: M 6.1 — 17 km W of Río Grande, Panama (Oct 12)
items.summary: Magnitude 6.1 earthquake on October 12, continuing the Panama sequence that began October 9; PAGER alert green.

physical.note: Panama has had three significant earthquakes since October 9. No October-dated typhoon, wildfire or flood events surfaced in today's search.
